first.text:
Got it. Before I write the draft, here is what I'm working from, so you can correct anything that's wrong:

- Six days, Thursday off. Weekdays capped at about 75 minutes, weekends at about 90.
- Home kit: Ironmaster Quick-Lock bar, dumbbells and kettlebell on one plate pool, bench with pull-up bar and dip station, box, bands, rings. No machines or cables at home.
- Tuesday evening is the PT session at the gym, alternating chest and back with legs and core. Its content is the trainer's and stays as it is.
- The change is one line: Incline Curl (Dumbbell), 3×8–12 at RPE 8 on double progression, added as the last line of Monday's OHP session, after the rear delt flys. Everything else in pv-3 stays the same.

That's a swap inside the same split, so this goes in as an `amend` of the current version, not a redesign. Your old routine's note on it was "add 2.5 lb per hand once every set reaches the top of the range", and I'll match that.

The one thing I need is a start load. I'll pull your last logged incline curl sets from the history rather than ask you to remember, then write the draft, run the adopt dry run and show you exactly what it fills in (load, rest, Monday's time estimate against the 75-minute cap, and any warnings). Nothing gets recorded until you've seen that and said yes.

If anything above is off, or you'd rather set the start load yourself, say so now.
